description: Chloé drifts in and laser-scans an empty browser; the site (navbar, hero, features, palette, footer) assembles section by section, gets a 'Built with AI!' sticker, dissolves, and she drifts out. The whole course in one visual.

'11 steps. One website.' Snake pipeline of all 11 steps (Pinterest, OriginKit, ColorHunt, Layout, Design spec, Bolt.new, arena.ai + Stitch, Download, Claude, GitHub Pages, Your domain). A glowing pulse carries Chloé along the path, lighting each step and a live step counter.

Bolt.new window: a rough 11-word prompt is typed, '+' then 'Enhance prompt' is clicked, Chloé zaps it, and a 62-word structured design-spec prompt streams in (Build / Sections / Hero / Palette / Animation / Details) with a before/after word-count chip.
suggestedSlide: step 06 Bolt.new (also works for step 05 design spec)

description: Illustrative animation, not a screen recording: the model names in it (Gemini-3.8-flash, Claude-sonnet-5-high) are placeholders, so caption it as 'how it works', never as real footage. 'Same prompt. Two AIs.' Model A vs Model B build two different bakery sites live (bento vs editorial) with code streaming; Chloé inspects both with lasers, 'Pick your favorite!' then a pick gets a 'my favorite!' sticker and 'download the code'. Callout: stitch.withgoogle.com = 4 designs to choose from.

New tab: yourname.com is typed, the page loads and goes LIVE (https lock), confetti bursts, Chloé celebrates and fires laser fireworks; chips for 'GitHub Pages · free hosting', 'Domain · $5-12 / year', 'HTTPS · secure'; caption 'You're live on the internet!'.
